sources.field: Estimated people living with myeloma in the United States, 2023
U.S. resident population on July 1, 2023, as published in the 2024 facts sheet

limitations: The disease pool is an estimated national prevalence count, not people available or eligible for recruitment.

The population denominator is the pinned July 1 estimate. The disease source reports a year, not an identical reference date. Derived per-100000 ratios are illustrative and are not a published SEER prevalence rate.
Reference values are historical and pinned, not automatically refreshed or projected to the current year.
No transfer of the national reference to states, cities or other countries.
Eligibility and accessibility shares are explicitly entered assumptions; registry counts do not estimate them.
